name: Southwest Airlines
description: Southwest flies scheduled passengers across the US and near-international markets, mostly short-haul point-to-point routes using secondary airports such as Dallas Love Field, Chicago Midway and Burbank. It long offered free checked bags and open seating; in 2025-26 it changed these: bag fees on most fares from May 28, 2025, a Basic fare, and assigned seating (with extra-legroom seats) from January 27, 2026. Revenue was $28.1B in 2025, 91 percent from tickets; operating income was only $428M. In the June 2026 quarter revenue rose 16 percent to $8.4B and operating income to $285M. It carries about $1.7B of remaining buyback authority and an investment-grade rating from all three agencies.

gics.note: Conventional filing: GICS sector and 'Passenger Airlines' sub-industry as listed on Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (read 2026-10-01); the list does not show the industry group or industry. SEC SIC code 4512 (Air Transportation, Scheduled) per EDGAR.

hq.note: Dallas, TX per EDGAR business address and Wikipedia S&P 500 list

employees.note: 72,790 active full-time-equivalent employees (32,214 air operations, 21,734 ground operations, others); +0.5 percent in 2025 after a February 2025 cut of about 1,750 corporate roles (15 percent of corporate positions). FY2025 10-K

businessLines.name: Passenger
businessLines.how: Customers pay per ticket at booking; since 2025 also pay for checked bags and, from 2026, preferred and extra-legroom seats, which raises revenue per passenger. Profit hinges on load factor, yield and costs, with salaries, wages and benefits 46.9 percent of operating expense in 2025.
businessLines.description: Scheduled passenger service; includes fares, bag fees and seat selection fees introduced in 2025-2026, and Rapid Rewards redemptions.

businessLines.name: Other (loyalty, co-brand cards and services)
businessLines.how: Card issuers and partners pay for Rapid Rewards points; points do not expire and are redeemed against flights. Composition of the $2,357M was not itemised in the excerpts read.
businessLines.description: 'Other' operating revenue, which includes Rapid Rewards loyalty and credit card partner revenue and ancillary services.

businessLines.name: Freight
businessLines.description: Cargo and freight carried on passenger flights.
